videos.title: This PC hasn't powered on since 2016. Until now.
videos.description:
The MSI X99S XPOWER AC + Intel Core i7-5930K, dark since 2016. Last time we said the board wants 8+4 pin CPU power. No AX1500i, no 4-pin: one 8-pin from a 500 W non-modular Thermaltake, and it lights up.

Next: does it POST?
Full dossier: forgotten-industries.net

#x99 #pcbuilding #retrocomputing #techrestoration

Music: "Misdirection" by The Grey Room / Density & Time (YouTube Audio Library).

videos.title: This X99 board wants 8+4 pin power. Our PSUs have 8.
videos.description:
The MSI X99S XPOWER AC has an 8-pin and a 4-pin CPU power connector. Both of our known-good power supplies are non-modular with a single 8-pin CPU cable. So out comes a Corsair AX1500i: 1500 W, fully modular, and missing every one of its cables. Modular cables aren't interchangeable between PSUs, so it's a hunt for its own.

Next: the first power-on since 2016.
Full dossier: forgotten-industries.net

#x99 #pcbuilding #corsair #psu #techrestoration

Music: "A Dyin' Breed" by The Grey Room / Density & Time (YouTube Audio Library).

videos.title: First boot runs on air. Then this goes on.
videos.description:
The water-cooling mock-up for the X99 rebuild: an EK Supremacy CPU block and a MOSFET block over the VRM, set in position on the MSI X99S XPOWER AC. Not installed yet. The first power-on since 2016 runs on an air cooler; the loop stays dry until the board boots and passes a leak test.

Full dossier: forgotten-industries.net
